records.statement: Binance's 12-hour PoR snapshot target elapsed at 2026-10-31T07:33Z, but no public result was located by 11:07Z. Binance states results by November 2; CoinDesk reports a November 1 reserve snapshot. Actual snapshot execution time and publication remain unknown.
CoinDesk's Binance14/16 reserve analysis concerns Ethereum hot wallets and ETH coverage. It does not establish that the five XRPL incident source wallets are in Binance's XRP reserve address set.

The latest previously archived Elliptic XRPL receiver observation is approximately 04:30 UTC. No raw XRPL account_info or complete transaction-history verification was executed at the 11:07 UTC cutoff.

The 233.46M XRP theft, CryptoQuant's approximately 220M Binance reserve decline and XRP Insights' daily/weekly exchange-balance changes use different address universes and windows. No five-wallet crosswalk or same-time XRP customer-liability reconciliation exists.

TradRadar's $1.85B OI is one provider's seven-venue aggregate. Contract inclusion, quote currency, open-interest units and timestamps remain unreconciled across providers. Account long/short is not notional exposure.

Alpha Finance's XRP ETF flow series ends at the October 29 session and does not publish AUM, current holdings or fees. Cumulative net flow is not current fund size, same-day spot execution or net external capital.

Entity sentiment/co-occurrence remains all-history with no timestamp filter, no deduplication and no source-independence adjustment. PR #1409 correctly labels outputs exploratory-only; no predictive feature admission is allowed.

The baseline chronology guard is verified on PR #1410 exact head but remains draft/unmerged and is not active on main. The fixed-horizon ledger is not a trained model or walk-forward evaluation system.

Main still contains scheduled Cross Analysis and Scheduler Tick write paths plus the unsafe Databricks token-input workflow. PRs #1408, #1407 and #1405 are open/draft/unmerged; fixes are not active on main.
The nine-platform capability map remains design-only for external platforms. No Claude, Grok, Gemini, Copilot, Codex, Hugging Face, Kaggle or Databricks authentication or live handoff was verified.
